summary: ADS-TEC Energy PLC, an Irish-domiciled Nasdaq-listed maker of battery-buffered fast-charging systems, furnished a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) containing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated results for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The release cites EU battery-electric vehicle registrations at a 21.7% market share year-to-date through August 2026, German registrations up 53%, a EUR 20.3 million order backlog and progress on a gigawatt-scale SKM storage project. No transaction, stake, price, premium or advisor is disclosed, so this is a routine earnings filing rather than a special situation.
